title: XREPOTEST: Benchmarking Multilingual Repository-Level Unit Test Generation for Large Language Models
datasets: XRepoTest: 3,642 focal functions; Rust 931, Go 706, Julia 684, PHP 646, Ruby 675. Defects4J appears only as related work.
models: 14 models including Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-Coder-Next-80B; custom Qwen2.5-Coder-7B via OpenAI-compatible endpoint is independent evaluation.
license: GitHub MIT; public HF dataset card MIT; upstream repository data retains original terms.
input_setting: Current-code focal function; repo context; test generation and execution; no issue/F2P buggy-fixed pair.
reproduction_grade: B for bounded custom-model evaluation; conditional for exact full 14-model rerun.
concept_hook: Invocation Rate: directly checks whether generated tests call the focal method; complements pass/coverage/mutation.
limitation: No Java/Python, no Defects4J experimental cohort/BugsInPy/SWT-Bench; no F2P or RCA. Mutation only Go/Rust/Ruby. Docker image tags are mutable latest.
